# usbxhci is written in Rust from the start (usbxhci-rust, libusbxhci_rust.a); there is no C
# implementation. rust_stub.c only gives add_library a translation unit.

# usbxhci.sys is all Rust (usbxhci-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/usbxhci-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(usbxhci_shims OBJECT rust_stub.c)
target_link_libraries(usbxhci_shims PRIVATE libusbport libhal libntoskrnl)
add_cargo_module(usbxhci usbxhci-cargo usbxhci.sys
    KIND kernelmodedriver
    BODY_CRATE usbxhci-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32/drivers
    NO_CAB
    EXTRA_DEPENDS usbxhci_shims psdk)
